system.description:
When you're targeted by a Strike, make a Smarts Check against the attacker's CR. Match it and you take no damage from that Strike; exceed it and you may also Strike the attacker if it's within Range.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.48
system.summary: When you're targeted by a Strike, make a Smarts Check against the attacker's CR. Match it and you take no damage from that Strike; exceed it and you may also Strike the attacker if it's within Range.

automation.onSuccess: Match: no damage from the Strike. Exceed: you may also Strike the attacker if it's within Range.

automation.note: Roll when targeted by a Strike, with the CR set to the attacker's CR. Match: take no damage from it. Exceed: you may also Strike the attacker if it's within Range.
